# Community Rule Column 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** complete

---

**9:1** They shall not depart from any counsel of the Torah to walk in the stubbornness of their heart, but shall be governed by the first

**9:2** regulations by which the men of the community were first instructed, until the coming of a prophet and the Messiahs of Aaron and Israel.

**9:3** These are the statutes for the Instructor to walk by them with every living being, according to the regulation of

**9:4** every time and the weight of every man: to do the will of God according to all

**9:5** that has been revealed for each time, and to acquire all the wisdom that has been found according to

**9:6** the times and the statute of the time. He shall separate and weigh the Sons of Righteousness according to their spirits,

**9:7** and hold fast to the chosen ones of the time according to his will, as he has commanded. Each man

**9:8** according to his spirit shall he judge; according to the cleanness of his hands shall he be admitted, and according to his understanding

**9:9** shall he be advanced — and likewise his love together with his hatred. He shall not reprove or dispute

**9:10** with the men of the pit, but shall conceal the counsel of the Torah among the men of injustice.

**9:11** He shall reprove with true knowledge and righteous judgment those who choose the way, each man according to his spirit,

**9:12** according to the regulation of the time, guiding them in knowledge and instructing them in the mysteries of

**9:13** wonder and truth, so that within the community they may walk perfectly, each man with his neighbor,

**9:14** in all that has been revealed to them. This is the time for clearing the way

**9:15** to the wilderness. He shall instruct them in all that is required at this time, and to separate

**9:16** from every man who has not turned his way from all injustice.

**9:17** These are the regulations of the way for the Instructor in these times, for his loving and for his hating:

**9:18** eternal hatred for the men of the pit in a spirit of secrecy, leaving to them property and the labor of

**9:19** hands as a slave to his ruler, and humility before the one who has dominion over him.

**9:20** Each man shall be zealous for the statute and its time, for the day of vengeance. He shall perform

**9:21** the will of God in every undertaking of his hands and in all his dominion, as

**9:22** he has commanded. Everything that befalls him he shall accept willingly, and apart from the will of

**9:23** God nothing shall give him pleasure. He shall delight in all the words of his mouth and shall desire

**9:24** nothing that he has not commanded. He shall look continually to the judgment of God.

**9:25** In distress he shall bless his Maker, and in all that befalls him he shall recount

**9:26** his covenant-faithfulness, and amid the endurance of affliction he shall bless him. At all times he shall pray.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 9 contains the famous dual-messiah passage (line 2). "Messiahs" (plural) is preserved over PNEUMA's "Anointed Ones" since the term mashiach is central to scholarly discussion of this passage. "Men of the pit" (lines 10, 18) is retained as the standard DSS rendering over PNEUMA's "people of destruction." "Covenant-faithfulness" (line 26) follows the project's established rendering for hesed. The Maskil/Instructor passage closely follows LOGOS with minor adjustments.*
